nodes.label: Shader Staging Guard
nodes.rationale: utest_SEN_shader_staging compares the shaders the runtime actually compiles against the shaders in the repository. The source directory, the staged directory, and the shader name list are injected as compile definitions from the same CMake variables that generate the staging rules, so the test cannot silently disagree with the build about which shaders exist. The names are injected rather than discovered by globbing the staged directory, because a glob would pass vacuously if staging had produced nothing at all. An empty CH_SENSOR_STAGED_SHADER_NAMES is a FATAL_ERROR rather than a skip, so a staging block that failed to export the variable is caught at configure time. The list is joined with commas before being passed as a -D flag because a semicolon is CMake's list separator and would expand into one flag per shader, mangling the command line.

nodes.label: RNG Streams Test Kept Outside OptiX Gate
nodes.rationale: utest_SEN_rng_streams is deliberately registered outside the CH_USE_SENSOR_OPTIX block because it tests the seed algebra and stream identity assignment, not cuRAND itself, and so must also run in configurations built without OptiX.

edges.source_location: Both inject build-time path knowledge into a test target from a CMake variable rather than letting the test hard-code or discover the location
